Title: Smaller SKUs for Azure SQL Data Warehouse Gen2

Body.Content:
Azure SQL Data Warehouse (SQL DW) is a fast, flexible, and secure analytics platform. The industry-leading query performance of the Compute Optimized Gen2 tier of SQL DW is now accessible to more customers through new, smaller SKUs: DW100c, DW200c and DW300c. With this release, customers can get started with a powerful data warehouse in the cloud for as low as $1.50/hour (in the US East region, price varies by region). This new SKU will be generally available on December 4 across 15 Azure global regions.

Upgrade to the latest generation.
